description_en: This L-shaped two storey phalcā is located at Bhelāchẽ Square, just opposite the Bhelāchẽ Ṭīkābhairava Temple. Its east-facing façade has five bays, whilst the façade facing north has three bays. Traditional Newar style windows can be seen on the first floor with five to the east and three to the north. The windows are arranged according to the bays on the ground floor, which is used for resting as well as religious activities. The upper floor is currently used as an office space for community workers. The structure has a traditional tiled roof.There are two inscriptions on the wall of the Bhelāchẽ Phalcā. The first inscription mentions that a three-bay north-facing phalcāwas commissioned by Guhya Lakṣmī Brāhmaṇī in NS 943 (1823 AD), whilst the second informs readers of the renovation of the phalcāundertaken by the Mahāju family. The inscription points to the existence of two different phalcā,which seem to have later been joined together to become one. According to local informants, the Mahāju family who are the descendants of the donor filed a court case against Bhelāchẽ Tol a few decades ago, claiming that one of these phalcā was their private property. Bhelāchẽ Tol ultimately won the case (source: Dhanalāl Avāle, 76, local informant).
description_ne: एल् आकारको दुईतले फल्चा भलाछेँ चोकमा भलाछेँ टीकाभैरव मन्दिरको ठीक अगाडि रहेको छ । फल्चाको पूर्वी मोहडामा  पाँच कवल छन् भने उत्तरी मोहडामा चार कवल छन् । फल्चाको पहिलो तलामा पुराना कलात्मक झ्याल छन् र माथि पारम्परिक टायलको छानो छ । झ्यालहरू तलका कवल अनुसार मिलाइएका छन्, पूर्वमा पाँचवटा झ्याल र उत्तरमा तीन वटा झ्याल छन् । फल्चाको भुइँतला आराम गर्न र धार्मिक गतिविधिहरू गर्नका लागि प्रयोग गरिन्छ भने माथिल्लो तलामा सामुदायिक कल्याणको कार्यालय रहेको छ ।फल्चाको भित्तामा दुईवटा शिलालेख रहेका छन् । पहिलो शिलालेखमा दिइएको जानकारी अनुसार यो फल्चा नेसं ९४३ मा गुह्यलक्ष्मी ब्राह्मणीले स्थापना गरेकी हुन् । फल्चामा भएको अर्को शिलालेखमा महाजु परिवारले बनाएको फल्चाको पुनर्निर्माण गरिएको कुराको जानकारी दिइएको छ । स्थानीय वासिन्दाले दिएको जानकारी अनुसार केही दशक पहिला दाताका सन्तति महाजु परिवारले यो फल्चा आफ्नो व्यक्तिगत सम्पत्ति भएको दाबी गर्दै टोलवासीका विरुद्धमा अदालतमा मुद्दा दर्ता गरे, तर उनीहरूको दाबी प्रमाणित हुन सकेन । शिलालेखको आधारमा त्यहाँ पहिला दुईवटा फल्चा रहेको र पछि ती दुई फल्चा जोडिएर एउटै भएको देखिन्छ । तर पनि त्यहाँ दुई वटा अलग-अलग फल्चा रहेको कुरा स्थानीयवासीहरूलाई संझना छैन ।

historical_events.event_description: Bhelāchẽ Phalcāwas renovated in VS 2032 (1975 CE), this time using concrete.
In 2017 CE, Bhelāchẽ Phalcā was renovated by the Bhelāchẽ community and Lalitpur Metropolitan City in a traditional Newar style.

Guhya Lakṣmī Brāhmaṇī commissioned this Phalcā. He instructed that beaten rice 1phã, syābaji1mānā, soy beans 1mānā,bean 1prasthafish and 1prasthaginger should be distributed at Bhelāchẽ Phalcā on the full moon day of Bhādra. Three lamps should also be lit on this day.
Bhelāchẽ Phalcāwas completely destroyed in the 1934 earthquake. Pūrṇalāla Mahāju and his wife and son organised for it to be rebuilt.
